task_completion.description: Agent opens or reads the source data file at ~/pebl/data/igt_data.csv
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., cat, head, pandas read) or a text editor showing the contents of igt_data.csv.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies and excludes participants with 100% selection of one deck (e.g., sub-999).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or terminal output showing logic to drop participants who only chose one deck type throughout the session.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates net scores for five 20-trial blocks using the formula (C+D) - (A+B).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code snippets or intermediate execution outputs showing the math for 5 distinct blocks per participant.

task_completion.description: Agent calculates the learning effect as (mean of blocks 4 & 5) - (mean of blocks 1 & 2).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or output showing the subtraction of the average of the first two blocks from the average of the last two blocks.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the final analysis to ~/pebl/analysis/igt_report.json with the required structure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command showing the creation of the file or a 'cat' command displaying the JSON content containing 'participants', 'id', and the calculated metrics.

integrity.description: Agent performs actual data processing rather than hardcoding values.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show Python scripts or data processing commands, not just a manual creation of a JSON file with pre-filled numbers.

integrity.description: Agent specifically excludes the contaminated participant based on data analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final JSON or intermediate logs should show that 'sub-999' is missing from the final report due to the perseverative strategy filter.

integrity.description: Agent uses the specific file paths requested in the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: The code or terminal commands must explicitly reference ~/pebl/data/igt_data.csv and ~/pebl/analysis/igt_report.json.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source data contains a participant 'sub-999' who always chooses Deck A; this participant must be excluded from the final JSON report. The final report must be located at /home/ga/pebl/analysis/igt_report.json. The net score formula is (Decks C + D) minus (Decks A + B).
